evals.prompt: I watched a video where the guy sells a Bank Nifty ATM straddle at 9:30, exits one leg when its premium doubles, and re-sells that leg at the new ATM, max twice. Target 25% of collected premium, stop 40%. Build this as a strategy I can start from the dashboard. Dry run by default, but I want to be able to run it live on Zerodha later.
evals.expected_output: A new strategies/<family>/ script derived from the skeleton plus strategy.md: --live default off, --broker, --instance-id, %-target via parse_target_spec resolved once, per-leg SL roll capped by --max-rolls, own-quantity exits via resolve_exit_qty_broker, confirmed closes with retry status, save_strategy_state/check_shutdown_trigger, config validation, strategy.md with failure-mode table, plus the strategyRegistry.ts entry, the logs-route entry and StrategyCard/StrategyRowWide branches.

evals.prompt: Add a re-entry to nifty_rolling_straddle: after a leg-SL roll fails to reopen the replacement leg, retry the entry on the next tick instead of staying flat for the rest of the day. Be careful, this thing trades real money.
